Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:11:1.hebrew: מכרן לא' או לג' בני אדם - ביום א'. מי שהיה עליו נזקין וכתובת אשה וב"ח, והיו לו עידית ובינונית וזיבורית:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:11:1.english: He sold them to one or to three people - On one day. [The baraita refers to] one who had [obligations for] damages, a woman's ketubah, and a creditor, and he had superior, intermediate, and inferior [land].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:11:2.hebrew: כולן נכנסו תחת הבעלים - נכנסו הלקוחות כדין המוכר, ומי שלקח עידית יפרע לניזק, ולוקח בינונית ישלם את החוב, ולוקח זיבורית את הכתובה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:11:2.english: All of them entered in place of the owner - The buyers entered into the legal status of the seller: whoever bought superior-quality land shall pay the injured party, and the buyer of intermediate-quality land shall pay the debt, and the buyer of inferior-quality land [shall pay] the marriage contract.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:12:1.hebrew: מן האחרון - דאפי' שקלו קמאי עידית ובינונית, מצי מדחן להו הלקוחות לנזקין וב"ח אצל זיבורית, דאמר: הנחתי לך מקום לגבות הימנו. ותנן במסכת גיטין (דף מח:): אין נפרעים מנכסים משועבדים במקום שיש בני חורין, ואפי' הן זיבורית. דכי זבון הני תרי קמאי, אשתייר זיבורית בני חורין, ואע"פ דהדר איזדבנא, בתר בתרא אזלינן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:12:1.english: From the last [buyer] - For even if the earlier [buyers] took superior and intermediate [land], the buyers can push off the [claimants for] damages and the creditor to the inferior [land], since [each one] says, "I left you room from which to collect." And we learned in a Mishnah in Tractate Gittin (48b): "One does not exact payment from encumbered property where there is unencumbered property, even if it is inferior [land]." For when these two earlier [buyers] purchased [their land], the inferior [land] remained unencumbered; and even though it was subsequently sold, we follow the last [buyer].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:12:2.hebrew: אין לו - כדי סיפוק שלשתן, שאין אותו קרקע שוה כל כך:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:12:2.english: [If] he does not have - enough to satisfy the three of them, for that land is not worth that much.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:12:3.english: [He] collects - the remainder from [the one] before him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:14:1.english: If we say [he sold them] simultaneously - [i.e.,] in a single deed.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:14:2.hebrew: השתא לג' דאיכא למימר חד מינייהו קדים - שזה לקח בבוקר והללו שנים בערב, ומצי למיטען "הנחתי לך מקום":
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:14:2.english: Now, to three [buyers], where it is possible to say [that] one of them preceded [the others] - For this one bought in the morning and those two [bought] in the evening, and [the first buyer] could claim, "I left you room [to collect from]."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:14:3.english: You say they entered in place of the owners - Since it is not discernible in the deed of sale who purchased first.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:15:1.hebrew: אלא בזה אחר זה - בג' ימים:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:15:1.english: Rather, one after the other - On three [separate] days.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:17:2.english: I left a place for you to collect - So that all of them [the creditors] go after the inferior-quality land.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:18:1.english: That he purchased superior-quality land last - For it is preferable to him to give them according to their [legal] entitlements, and [that] they should not go after the superior-quality land.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:19:1.hebrew: ליגבו מעידית - כלומר, מעידית שנשארה בת חורין בב' הלקוחות, והוטל שיעבודן עליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:19:1.english: Let them collect from [the] superior-quality [land] - That is to say, from the superior-quality [land] that remained unencumbered in [the case of] the two purchasers, and their lien was placed upon it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:1:1.hebrew: עידית וזיבורית נזקין בעידית ובעל חוב וכתובת אשה בזיבורית - מדאורייתא ב"ח בזיבורית, כדלקמן. ורבנן הוא דתקון ליה בבינונית משום נעילת דלת ללוין, והיכא דלית ליה בינונית ליתא לתקנתא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:1:1.english: Best-quality [land] and worst-quality [land] — damages are paid from the best-quality, while a creditor and a woman's marriage contract [are collected] from the worst-quality - By Torah law, a creditor collects from the worst-quality [land], as [stated] below. It was the Rabbis who enacted for him [collection] from medium-quality [land], so as not to lock the door before borrowers; and where he has no medium-quality [land], the enactment does not apply.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:20:1.hebrew: ואי לא מהדרנא לשטרא דזיבורית למריה - כי היכי דתהדרו למיגבא מיניה, דאין נפרעין מנכסים משועבדים במקום שיש בני חורין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:20:1.english: And if not, I will return the deed of the inferior-quality [land] to its owner - So that you will go back to collecting from him, for one does not collect from encumbered property where there is unencumbered [property].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:21:1.english: If so - [meaning] that it is because of this reason.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:2:1.english: Make his medium [field] like the best - For it is his best [property].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:3:1.english: And he sold it - After the loan, since the middling [land] had been bound to the creditor from the outset, while the choice land was still in his possession.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:7:1.hebrew: אידי ואידי שלא היתה לו עידית - ודכ"ע בשל עולם הן שמין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:7:1.english: Both this and that [refer to a case where] he had no *idit* [land] - And according to everyone, they assess [the damages] from the property of the world, [i.e., the average land of the general population].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:7:2.hebrew: ולא קשיא כו' - הא דקתני ב"ח וכתובת אשה בזיבורית, דשויא בינונית דידיה כעידית דעלמא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:7:2.english: And it is not difficult, etc. - That which it teaches that a creditor and a woman's marriage contract [are collected] from the poorest-quality land is [in a case] where his medium-quality [land] is equivalent to the best-quality land of other people.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:8:1.hebrew: אידי ואידי [כגון] שהיתה בינונית שלו כבינונית דעלמא - ולא היתה לו עידית מתחילה, ובהא פליגי: דתנא דמתניתא קמייתא סבר בשל עולם הן שמין, ואמטו להכי שקיל ב"ח בבינונית כדיניה, ואידך סבר בשלו הן שמין. ל"א גרסינן אידי ואידי כגון שהיתה בינונית שלו כעידית דעלמא, ומפרשינן ליה הכי: אידי ואידי כשהיתה לו עידית ומכרה, ובהא פליגי: דתנא דמתניתא קמייתא סבר בשלו הן שמין, וכיון דלדידיה הואי בינונית, אע"ג דלעלמא עידית, מיניה משלם; ותנא דברייתא סבר בשל עולם הן שמין. ותפוס לשון ראשון:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:8:1.english: Both this and that [refer to a case where] his average-quality [land] was like the average-quality [land] of everyone else - and he did not originally have any best-quality land. And in this they disagree: the Tanna of the first Mishnah holds that they assess according to [the land of] people in general, and therefore the creditor collects from average-quality land as is his due; and the other holds that they assess according to his own [land]. Another explanation: We read, "Both this and that [refer to a case where] his average-quality [land] was like the best-quality land of everyone else," and we explain it thus: both this and that refer to a case where he had best-quality land and sold it. And in this they disagree: the Tanna of the first Mishnah holds that they assess according to his own [land], and since for him it was average-quality, even though for others it is best-quality, he pays from it; and the Tanna of the Baraita holds that they assess according to [the land of] people in general. And hold on to the first explanation.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:9:1.hebrew: בדעולא קמיפלגי - תנא בתרא לית ליה תקנתא דעולא, אלא בתר קרא אזיל. ואפילו הוי ליה נמי עידית — דהשתא הואי ליה בינונית גמורה בין לדידיה בין לעלמא — אפילו הכי ס"ל דלשקול ב"ח מזיבורית:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 8a:9:1.english: They disagree with regard to [the opinion of] Ulla - The latter tanna does not accept Ulla's enactment, but rather follows the verse. And even if [the debtor] also has superior-quality [land] — so that he now has true intermediate-quality [land], both relative to himself and relative to everyone [else] — even so, he holds that a creditor collects from inferior-quality [land].

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:10:1.hebrew: מר לית ליה תקנתא דעולא - דוקא היכא דלית ליה עידית, דהוי האי בינונית עידית לדידיה. מדנקט בינונית וזבורית, משמע דאי אית ליה עידית, גבי ב"ח מבינונית. וקסבר כיון דלית ליה אלא בינונית וזיבורית — דשייך כאן טעמא דאמר בהניזקין (גיטין מט:): מפני מה ב"ח אין דינו בעידית? כדי שלא יראה שדה נאה ודירה נאה לחבירו ויאמר "אקפוץ ואלונו כדי שאגבה אותה בחובי":
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:10:1.english: [And the other] Sage does not hold [by] the ordinance of Ulla - [This applies] specifically where [the debtor] does not have superior-quality land, so that this intermediate-quality land is [effectively] superior-quality land for him. Since [the baraita] specifies intermediate-quality and inferior-quality land, it implies that if he [did] have superior-quality land, a creditor would collect from the intermediate-quality land. And [this Tanna] holds that since he has only intermediate-quality and inferior-quality land, the reason stated in [the chapter] HaNizakin (Gittin 49b) applies here: Why is a creditor's [collection] right not from superior-quality land? So that one should not see a fine field or a fine dwelling belonging to his fellow and say, "I will jump at the opportunity and lend him [money] so that I may collect it for my debt."

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:11:1.hebrew: כולן נכנסו תחת הבעלים - וא"ת, והא נזקין מלוה על פה נינהו, ומלוה על פה לא גבי ממשעבדי? וי"ל דכשעמד בדין כמלוה בשטר דמיא, כדאמר בהגוזל בתרא (לקמן קיב) ובכמה דוכתין. אי נמי, מלוה הכתובה בתורה ככתובה בשטר דמיא, וחייב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:11:1.english: All [the buyers] replace the [land's prior] owner - And if you should ask: But damages are an oral obligation [not recorded in a document], and an oral obligation cannot be collected from encumbered [sold] property? One can answer that once he stood in court [for judgment], it is like a loan recorded in a document, as it says in [chapter] HaGozel Batra (below, 112[a]) and in several [other] places. Alternatively, an obligation written in the Torah is like one written in a document, and [therefore] he is liable.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:12:1.hebrew: אין לו גובה משלפניו - אומר ריב"א, שאם באו כולם בבת אחת, כל הקודם בשטר גובה מן האחרון תחילה; ואם נזקין קדמו — גובה מן האחרון אפי' היא זיבורית, ואם בא ב"ח אחריו — יגבה נמי מן האחרון אם יש לו, ואם אין לו — גובה משלפניו ואפי' מן העידית, והאשה משלפני פניו ואפי' הן עידי עידית:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:12:1.english: If he does not have [sufficient land], he collects from the one before him - Riba says that if they all come at once, whoever is first in [the date of his] deed collects from the last [buyer] first. And if [a claimant for] damages was first, he collects from the last [buyer] even if it is inferior land; and if a creditor comes after him, he also collects from the last [buyer] if he [still] has [land], and if he does not have [any], he collects from the one before him, even from superior land; and the woman [collecting her ketubah collects] from the one before the one before him, even if they are the very best of superior land.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:14:1.english: Where it is possible to say that one of them preceded [the others] - Because they do not write the hours [in deeds], except in Jerusalem.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:14:2.hebrew: מכרן לאחד בבת אחת מיבעיא - השתא לא אסיק אדעתיה טעמא דאי שתקת, דאפילו כתוב הכל בשטר אחד, יכול לכבוש השטר ולהחזיר הזיבורית לבעלים כאלו לא קנה מעולם:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:14:2.english: [If] he sold them to one [person] simultaneously, is it necessary [to state]? - At this point, [the Gemara] had not yet considered the reason of "if you keep silent," for even if everything is written in a single deed, [the buyer] can suppress the deed and return the inferior land to the [original] owner as though he had never purchased [it].

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:20:1.hebrew: אי שתקת כו' ואי לא מהדרנא שטרא דזיבורית למריה - אע"ג דבלאו הכי אשה גביא מזיבורית, מ"מ לא מציא למימר ליה: "לכי תהדר", כיון שאין מפקיע כחה. אבל ב"ח — לא מצי הלוקח למימר דלישקול בזיבורית מטעם ד"אי שתקת", דכיון דמפקיע כחו, מצי א"ל: "לכי תהדר, דהא השתא נמי מזיבורית אתה רוצה ליתן לי". לכך לא פריך בסמוך אלא מנזקין ולא מב"ח, כדפירש הקונטרס [ועי' תוספות יבמות לז. ד"ה דאמר]:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:20:1.english: If you are silent, etc., and if not, I will return the bill [of sale] of the inferior-quality [land] to its owner - Even though in any case a woman collects [her marriage contract] from inferior-quality [land], nevertheless she cannot say to him, "When you return [it, go ahead]," since he is not diminishing her right. However, [as for] a creditor, [the buyer] cannot say that he should take inferior-quality [land] on the grounds of "If you are silent," for since he is diminishing his right, [the creditor] can say to him, "When you return [it, go ahead], for even now you want to give me from inferior-quality [land]." Therefore, [the Gemara] asks shortly below only from [the case of] the injured party and not from [the case of] a creditor, as Rashi explained. [See Tosafot on Yevamot 37a, s.v. De'amar.]

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:7:1.hebrew: ה"ג אידי ואידי בשלא היתה לו עידית ומכרה, הא דשויא בינונית דידיה כעידית דעלמא, הא דלא שויא כו' - והא דקאמר: "אידי ואידי כגון שלא היתה לו עידית ומכרה", ולא בעי למימר דתרוייהו מיירי שלא היה לו כלל — דא"כ, ההוא דמיירי דשויא בינונית דידיה כעידית דעלמא, אמאי קרי לה בינונית? אלא ה"ק: אידי ואידי שלא היתה לו עידית ומכרה, כלומר: לא איירי כשהיתה לו עידית ומכרה, אלא בחדא מיירי שלא היתה לו מעולם, וחדא מיירי כשהיתה לו ועדיין יש לו; ואין צריך לאוקמי כשמכר שום שדה, וסברי תרוייהו בשל עולם הן שמין:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:7:1.english: Thus we read: "Both this and that are where it is not [a case where] he had idit and sold it; this one, where his medium [land] is worth like the idit of the world; that one, where it is not worth [that], etc." - And as for what [the Gemara] says, "both this and that are where it is not [a case where] he had idit and sold it" — it does not mean to say that both discuss a case where he never had [idit] at all, for if so, regarding the one that discusses [the case] where his medium [land] is worth like the idit of the world, why does it call it "medium"? Rather, this is what it means: both this and that are where it is not [a case where] he had idit and sold it; that is, it does not discuss [a case] where he had idit and sold it, but rather, one [case] discusses where he never had [idit], and the other discusses where he had [idit] and still has it. And there is no need to establish [the case] as one where he sold some field, and both [Tannaim] hold that they assess according to [the standard of] the world.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:8:1.hebrew: ואי בעית אימא אידי ואידי כשהיתה בינונית שלו כבינונית דעלמא - ולא גרס "כעידית דעלמא", דכיון דקאי אשלא היתה לו עידית, אמאי קרי ליה בינונית, כיון דהוו עידית דידיה ודעלמא? ועוד, דא"כ היכי מתוקמא ההיא דקתני נזקין וב"ח בבינונית, בין למ"ד בשלו הן שמין בין למ"ד בשל עולם הן שמין:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:8:1.english: And if you wish, say: Both this [baraita] and that [baraita] [apply] when his intermediate-quality [land] was like the intermediate-quality [land] of the world - And we do not read [the text as] "like the superior-quality [land] of the world." For since [this statement] refers to [a case where] he did not have superior-quality [land], why would [the Gemara] call it "intermediate-quality," since it is [both] his superior-quality [land] and [that] of the world? And furthermore, if so, how could that [baraita] which teaches [that] damages and a creditor [collect] from intermediate-quality [land] be established, whether according to the one who says they appraise based on his [own land], or according to the one who says they appraise based on [the land of] the world?

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:9:1.hebrew: מה דרכו של אדם להוציא פחות שבכלים - אע"ג דשליח ב"ד היה מוציא, לא היה מוציאו אלא מה שהלוה נותן לו:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:9:1.english: "What does a person typically bring out? The most inferior of his utensils" - Even though the court's agent would bring [the collateral] out, he would only bring out whatever the borrower gives him.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:9:2.hebrew: להוציא פחות שבכלים - וא"ת: אפי' פחות שבכלים מיטב הוא, כדאמר לעיל "כל מילי מיטב הוא"? וי"ל: כשמוציא כלים, דרכו להוציא הגרוע; וכשמוציא קרקע נמי, דרכו להוציא זיבורית. ונראה דהלכה דבשלו הן שמין, דהכי אית ליה לר"נ בכתובות (דף קי.):
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 8a:9:2.english: To bring out — the most inferior of utensils - And if you ask: Even the most inferior of utensils is [considered] best-quality, as [the Gemara] stated above, "All movable items are [considered] best-quality"? One can answer: When he brings out utensils, it is his way to bring out the worst; and when he brings out land as well, it is his way to bring out inferior-quality [land]. And it appears that the halakhah is that we appraise [the quality] according to his own [property], for so Rav Nachman holds in Ketubot (110a).
